title: Mall dream where you try to find your school/ exit
content: So I’ve been having these somewhat similar dreams where I’m in this huge mall in the food court or just walking around trying to find the exit and sometimes my high school. Recently I’ve had one where I went to a food court and went to order in those food stalls (I don’t know what they called but they’re the counters that are right next to each other in malls). And I remember rushing to get my food so I could head back to school but I never could find my school? If that makes sense. Each time I exited there would either be greenery with a building in the distance that wasn’t my school, a parking lot and recently a soccer field. I’m just wondering if that means anything and if any of you guys know. If not that cool.
